attributions.chapter: CHAPTER XXXV THE INEVITABLE LAW OF TRANSMUTATION
attributions.surface_quote: the material goes to the material... the controlling powers... seek the realms of finer forces

canonical_statement: Consciousness undergoes a process of shedding its grosser form to ascend and adopting a finer form to descend.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER XXXV THE INEVITABLE LAW OF TRANSMUTATION
attributions.surface_quote: The Spirit strips itself to go up and clothes itself to go down

canonical_statement: The universe operates according to precise and immutable laws, compelling consciousness to manifest and express itself.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER XXXV THE INEVITABLE LAW OF TRANSMUTATION
attributions.surface_quote: The order of the Infinite Universe is exact... Mind is compelled to express itself

canonical_statement: There exists a known point of integration between the physical and non-physical dimensions of reality.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER XXXV THE INEVITABLE LAW OF TRANSMUTATION
attributions.surface_quote: The exact point of union between the visible and the invisible forces has been long known

canonical_statement: The divine or ultimate reality is characterized by order, though its workings may be beyond human comprehension.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER XXXV THE INEVITABLE LAW OF TRANSMUTATION
attributions.surface_quote: God is a God of order, though to scan His works may pose the feeble powers of man
